firn_layer_depletion.geography: Greenland Ice Sheet, with Antarctic retention context kept separate
firn_layer_depletion.boundary: Firn air content and retained meltwater are physical cryosphere states. They are not counts of people harmed, global ecosystem-collapse percentages or direct sea-level damage.

ice_cap_decapitation.geography: five historically ice-capped summits in Washington State, United States
ice_cap_decapitation.boundary: The survey measures summit ice and elevation change at five mountains. It does not establish global ice-cap area loss, harmed-person reach, ecosystem collapse or recovery time.

ice_shelf_grounding_line_retreat.geography: Antarctic Peninsula and Berry Glacier, West Antarctica
ice_shelf_grounding_line_retreat.boundary: Grounding-line position, ice speed, thickness and mass are physical-state measurements. Coastline mapping is observation coverage, and retreat distance is not human reach or ecosystem-collapse severity.

excluded_from_scoring: satellite or mapped coastline coverage treated as affected ecosystem distribution
ice mass, volume, elevation or retreat distance treated as harmed-person reach
observation period treated as consequence persistence
future melt or sea-level projections added to the current score
downstream sea-level, flood, water-supply or ecosystem-node ratings copied into these physical-state nodes
